description: This Java source file contains integration tests for HTTP endpoint checks on a running BankApp instance. It uses JUnit 5 and Spring Boot testing framework to verify health check endpoints, API documentation, Swagger UI, and H2 console accessibility, primarily through HTTP requests and response assertions.

classes.name: EndpointChecksIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class annotated for Spring Boot, performing HTTP checks against a running BankApp endpoint, including health, API docs, Swagger UI, and H2 console.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for endpoint testing, considering environment variable override and trimming trailing slashes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path or absolute URL, optionally setting an Accept header.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Checks if a given HTTP status code indicates a redirect.

methods.name: followRedirectOnce
methods.description: Follows a single HTTP redirect response, asserting presence of Location header, and returns the response after follow-up request.

methods.name: healthzReturnsOkJson
methods.description: Test method verifying that the /healthz endpoint returns status 'ok' in JSON.

methods.name: activatorHealthReportsUpStatus
methods.description: Test method verifying that the /actuator/health endpoint reports 'UP' status.

methods.name: openApiDocsContainOpenApiFieldOrSkipIfSwagger2
methods.description: Test method verifying presence of 'openapi' or 'swagger' field in API documentation JSON response.

methods.name: swaggerUiIsReachable
methods.description: Test method verifying the accessibility of Swagger UI HTML page and its content.

methods.name: h2ConsoleIsReachable
methods.description: Test method verifying H2 console page accessibility and content.
